name: Emelaigne Widdensov
source: Emelaigne is the eldest child of Ophelia and step-daughter of Genaro. Emelaigne is well liked by the common people, but has trouble fitting in with nobles.
translation: Emelaigne is the eldest child of Ophelia and step-daughter of Genaro. Emelaigne is well liked by the common people, but has trouble fitting in with nobles.
